description: Crawls an explicitly authorized website origin and applies ZAP's upstream passive scan rules to the responses it observes, reporting per-page findings without sending attack payloads.
notices: The passive scan reads only the responses returned by crawling; it sends no attack payloads and does not exercise ZAP's active scanner.

The pinned image loads 48 upstream add-ons. The Automation Framework (automation 0.60.0) is upstream beta and the passive scan framework (pscan 0.6.0) is upstream alpha; the rule pack itself (pscanrules 75.0.0) is upstream release.
The heap must be pinned on the command line because zap.sh sizes it from host memory and ignores the container memory limit.

ZAP ignores the proxy environment variables the product sets for managed engines, so the generated plan pins the managed-network gateway in its own configuration; without that setting the engine would reach the target directly.
